units.source_text: 肌肉的缝隙间，要是灌入了石膏，恐怕一定是这种感觉吧。

en.t: If plaster were poured into the gaps between the muscles, it would probably feel exactly like this.

units.source_text: 感觉已经睁开眼睛了，怎么会如此之黑？

en.t: It felt as though his eyes were already open, so why was it so dark?

units.source_text: 哪里窸窸窣窣地响，大概是老鼠在拖拽作窝的材料吧……

en.t: Something was rustling somewhere; perhaps a rat was dragging materials for its nest...

units.source_text: 喉咙口火辣辣的，像被戳过一刀似的疼痛……

en.t: The opening of his throat burned fiercely, aching as if it had been stabbed with a knife...

units.source_text: 内脏如污水处理厂一般泛着泡沫……

en.t: His internal organs seemed to be foaming like a sewage treatment plant...
He wanted badly to smoke a cigarette...

units.source_text: 不，在这之前先得喝口水……

en.t: No, before that he had to drink some water...
All at once, he was dragged back to reality...

units.source_text: 是呵，那不是老鼠，女人已经干起活来了！……

en.t: Yes, that was not a rat; the woman had already started working!...
How long had he been asleep, anyway?...

units.source_text: 他想爬起来，又有一股令人恐惧的力量使他蜷伏在被子里……

en.t: He tried to get up, but some terrifying force made him curl back under the quilt...

units.source_text: 他忽然想起来，掀开脸上的手巾，

en.t: He suddenly remembered, and lifted the towel from his face,

units.source_text: 从打开的门口射进了淡淡的、冰凉的月光，像遮着一层胶。

en.t: From the open doorway, faint, cold moonlight streamed in, as though covered with a layer of glue.

units.source_text: 不知从何时起，又进入半夜了。

en.t: Without his knowing when, it had become the middle of the night again.
